REFUTED by on-box evidence — see bug df2c-e4b8-496d-4698 (strained-bare-turnstone).

The auto-deploy / mid-review-restart hypothesis does not hold. Container recreation times for compose-review-bot-1 were 2026-08-01T23:25:04, 08-02T00:00:22, 08-02T03:59:28, 08-02T05:37:03 UTC. The four coverage-gap votes landed at 23:39:03, 00:22:11, 04:46:53 and 16:41:48 — each strictly INSIDE a single container's lifetime (1208's container 4bd32a5e5170 had been up 12h and kept reviewing afterwards). A SIGTERM would also not have emitted the 'git fetch ... timed out after 300s' line that each failure did emit.

The real mechanism is a transient GitHub git-fetch hang (reproduced: 2/25 runs of the exact fetch inside the container hung >320s, the other 23 took 1-3s) burning the 300s _GIT_TIMEOUT, which adapter.py:207-211 converts into a vote-bearing BLOCK, which reconcile.py:210 then treats as 'already voted' and skips forever.

This ticket's second half — 'fail-NO-VOTE instead of fail-closed for retryable conditions' — is the correct fix and is carried in df2c. The 'hourly cadence' half is not needed for this defect.
